# Router-name: rust_blog
**Commit time:** 2026.10.25
**Cookies?:** no
**Author:** AI (based on RSSHub /rust/blog, reimplemented)
**Introduction:** The official Rust blog (blog.rust-lang.org) — latest posts scraped from the full post listing, with publish dates (US Eastern time)
**Address:** rssust://rust_blog
**Example:** [rssust://rust_blog](/rust_blog)
**robots.txt:** blog.rust-lang.org robots.txt has Crawl-delay: 10, scraping allowed; rate limit of 600s recommended
**Parameter:**
1. **limit**
   Type of parameter: number
   Default value: 20
   Meaning: number of posts to return (max 100)
**Environment Variables:** no
